hypothesis: The admitted finite curve and rigid-transform source language can be evaluated exactly where its algebra permits and otherwise enclosed conservatively without changing saved nominal intent; a pose enclosure becomes an actual finite-cutter sweep enclosure only when translation, rotation and full cutter support extent are all accounted for.
falsification: Reject this contract if an admitted curve/transform class has neither a checked finite enclosure rule nor a named open obligation; if centreline error is accepted as a cutter-sweep certificate while finite cutter extent or rotation is omitted; or if subdivision changes endpoints, engagement, units, transform order, source identity or inherited error.

numeric_enclosure.certifying_scalar: canonical exact rational or directed interval endpoint with explicit dimension
numeric_enclosure.angle_source: exact rational turn_fraction; radians are derived symbolically/enclosed rather than decimalizing pi
numeric_enclosure.pi_upper_role: conservative upper bound only; it is not an exact value of pi and is not predicate authority
numeric_enclosure.rotation_evaluation: exact algebraic form where available, otherwise outward enclosure that contains the semantic rigid rotation
numeric_enclosure.distance_norm_rule: a componentwise L1 bound may conservatively bound Euclidean displacement; no square root is required to certify that upper bound

curve_classes.semantic_mapping: constant exact pose over the declared finite interval
curve_classes.applicability: admitted stationary engaged or non-engaged interval
curve_classes.subdivision_rule: no source change; any partition is derived and must preserve both interval endpoints and engagement
curve_classes.checked_bound: exact pose evaluator has zero curve error; actual-sweep error is still computed by the common finite-cutter bound

curve_classes.semantic_mapping: P(u)=(1-u)P0+uP1 for exact u in closed [0,1]
curve_classes.subdivision_rule: exact affine subdivision; source endpoints and semantic interior split point are retained
curve_classes.checked_bound: exact rational evaluation has zero curve error; a directed approximate evaluator must report its translation enclosure explicitly

curve_classes.semantic_mapping: oriented rigid rotation of the exact start radial vector about the normalized exact axis through the exact turn_fraction sweep
curve_classes.applicability: admitted circular arc with nonzero valid axis and source-semantic endpoint
curve_classes.subdivision_rule: split the exact turn_fraction; for N positive equal pieces, theta_bar = 2*(22/7)*abs(turn_fraction)/N is a rational upper bound on subarc radians and radial chord sag is <= radius*theta_bar^2/8
curve_classes.checked_bound: the rational sag inequality encloses positional chord error without treating pi as rational equality; exact source endpoint is restored at the semantic boundary
open_obligations: PB-007-01 for exact tangential/multiple/singular transcendental event decisions

curve_classes.semantic_mapping: circular-arc rotation plus exact u*axial_delta along the same fixed axis
curve_classes.subdivision_rule: arc and axial parameter are split by the same exact u interval; the circular transverse bound applies and exact linear axial interpolation adds zero source-level error
curve_classes.checked_bound: translation enclosure is the conservative sum of transverse arc enclosure and any explicitly certified axial evaluator error; parameter correlation may not be separated
open_obligations: PB-007-01 for singular transcendental event equality
PB-007-02 for the general coupled helical/spindle-feed/eccentric sweep-membership route

curve_classes.semantic_mapping: finite ordered composition of exact line pieces; semantic zero-length pieces remain when they mark a boundary
curve_classes.subdivision_rule: subdivide only inside an existing line piece or at its exact vertex; never fit across a vertex, engagement boundary or source-semantic zero-length piece
curve_classes.checked_bound: each exact segment has zero curve error and the whole path bound is the maximum of segment bounds over the exact ordered union, not a cross-vertex shortcut

curve_classes.semantic_mapping: non-rational B-spline from exact degree, rational knots and exact control points under the Cox-de Boor definition
curve_classes.applicability: admitted finite non-rational B-spline; knot multiplicity is semantic
curve_classes.subdivision_rule: use exact knot insertion/span subdivision; each leaf keeps exact parameter endpoints and may use the exact control-hull enclosure or an exact derivative bound; no knot epsilon
curve_classes.checked_bound: on a leaf of parameter width h, an exact componentwise derivative L1 upper bound L gives displacement <= L*h; the exact local control hull is also a valid curve enclosure

curve_classes.semantic_mapping: finite ordered admitted pieces with explicit shared-boundary policy
curve_classes.subdivision_rule: piece boundaries are hard semantic boundaries; no fit may cross an engaged discontinuity or setup/tool/target/engagement transition
curve_classes.checked_bound: union the per-piece pose/sweep enclosures and preserve all shared semantic endpoints; error budgets compose monotonically rather than restarting per piece

curve_classes.semantic_mapping: exact finite time knots bind path progress and spindle phase to the same chronology; whole-turn geometric equivalence does not erase unwrapped phase/history
curve_classes.subdivision_rule: time, path and phase subdivide together from the same exact interval; independent full-angle coverage is forbidden
curve_classes.checked_bound: certified path and phase/rotation enclosures feed the common finite-cutter pose bound while preserving the shared time parameter
open_obligations: PB-007-01 for exact tangential/multiple/singular transcendental event decisions
PB-007-02 for the general coupled helical/spindle-feed/eccentric sweep-membership route

transform_classes.semantic_mapping: p_parent = R(q)*p_child+t using the exact source quaternion semantics, right-handed Cartesian frames and column vectors
transform_classes.checked_bound: a proper exact rigid transform preserves Euclidean distance bounds; an approximate evaluator must separately enclose translation and rotation-angle error before applying the finite-cutter bound

transform_classes.semantic_mapping: new immutable setup/frame definition composed in declared order; historical transform is not mutated
transform_classes.checked_bound: the post-transition pose is certified in the common workpiece frame and inherits prior source/numerical error without reset

transform_classes.semantic_mapping: explicit non-cutting transition to a new declared machine/setup frame while preserving body target and lineage bindings
transform_classes.checked_bound: composition uses the same rigid-transform covariance rule and retains units, order and body-target semantics

actual_sweep_bound.cutter_requirement: The effective cutting solid must have a certified finite support radius rho from the declared cutter-frame origin covering the complete cutting region, including finite radial extent, axial length, shoulders and any admitted nonconvex/undercut extent.
actual_sweep_bound.same_parameter_requirement: Exact and approximate poses cover the same closed engaged source parameter/time set, including semantic endpoints; trimming may not delete or extend engagement.
actual_sweep_bound.pose_bound: If translation displacement is <= e_translation and orientation angular displacement is <= e_rotation radians for every source parameter, every transformed cutter point moves by <= e_translation + rho*e_rotation because chord displacement is <= rho*angle.
actual_sweep_bound.tool_bound: If the derived cutter representation itself has certified Hausdorff error e_tool, add it conservatively.
actual_sweep_bound.inherited_bound: If upstream nominal-to-current error e_inherited is still part of the chain, add it conservatively unless a source-bound recomputation explicitly proves that channel removed.

proof_boundary.PO-02: OPEN: this contract specifies source-faithful sweep approximation/enclosure interfaces but does not implement every actual cutter sweep or prove all event membership.
proof_boundary.PO-05: OPEN: exact transcendental/singular and general coupled sweep blockers remain; a finite approximation budget is not a universal event-decision proof.
proof_boundary.PO-06: OPEN: this contract supplies one compositional error-transfer rule but not the complete source-to-reconstruction certificate chain.

blockers.remaining_obligation: unconditional finite exact decision for required tangential/multiple/singular transcendental events remains unestablished; MC-058 enclosures do not turn uncertainty into an equality verdict
the unconditional full constructive route for general coupled helical/spindle-feed/eccentric sweep membership remains unestablished; shared time/phase correlation must be preserved
